title: Example post — delete me
excerpt: A draft that shows how posts are stored. It never appears on the public site while published is false.
author: Harvestfield Healthcare
body:
How the blog works

Posts are written in the admin panel at /admin. Each save becomes a commit in the website repository, and the site rebuilds itself within about two minutes.

  • Drafts stay private.
  • Publishing makes the post live on the blog page.
  • Images you upload are stored alongside the post.
